messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I on the other hand got engaged last month after a 7 year relationship.

output.original_text: I on the other hand got engaged last month after a 7 year relationship.
output.joy: I’m so excited to share that I got engaged last month after a wonderful 7-year relationship!
output.sadness: I can’t help but feel bittersweet since I got engaged last month after a long 7-year relationship.
output.fear: Honestly, I’m a bit scared because I just got engaged last month after a 7-year relationship.
output.anger: I can’t believe I got engaged last month after a 7-year relationship when things feel so uncertain!
output.surprise: You won’t believe it, but I got engaged last month after being in a 7-year relationship!
output.disgust: I can’t wrap my head around the fact that I got engaged last month after a 7-year relationship.
